about: Reviews of the map's unperceived pool for this repository (0.2 map line). claim: the domain that should own it; the entry leaves the pool when that domain adds its row. delete: to be deleted (who uses it was measured first). unknown: cannot be measured. Every review has a reason. repositories: reviews of other repositories' entries (repository, then entry path), for repositories that have no review file of their own.
